messages.subject: Planned DMS maintenance — Saturday 18 October
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The document management system will be unavailable from 20:00 on Saturday 18 October until approximately 02:00 Sunday for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please save and close all documents beforehand. Email is unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
